svg.title: FIG-06 Current Core request and borrow states
svg.desc: READY: no provider borrow; SETTLED: provider's final access is release-publication; provider borrow remains valid; QUEUED; ACTIVE; DRAINING; QUARANTINED: storage and responsibility retained; fresh initialize; REJECTED / unborrowed prepare: no retained refs or residual effects; adapter ACCEPTED; direct provider ACCEPTED; executor progress; cancel / shutdown progress; completion / cancel / deadline; safe drain not established; drain failure; queue and related references drained; all necessary references drained; drain then release-publish; only after proven recovery and drain; consume and join observers, then prepare
